content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Lok Nayak Hospital Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi for filling up various Senior Resident positions through a walk-in interview process on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 64 vacancies available for the Senior Resident posts across multiple medical specialties such as Medicine, General Surgery, Pediatrics, and Neurosurgery.

faq.question: Q3. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The post name associated with this notification is Senior Resident across various specialized medical and surgical departments in Lok Nayak Hospital.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with a Post Graduate Degree, DNB, Diploma, or Post Doctoral Degree in the concerned medical specialty from an NMC or MCI recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying to the Senior Resident positions is 45 years calculated as on 01.07.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary according to Pay Matrix Level 11, ranging from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 208,700 per month along with other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q7. How can eligible candidates apply for these jobs?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly by bringing the prescribed application format along with original and self-attested photocopies of their required documents.

faq.question: Q8. When are the walk-in interviews scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled to be conducted on the 2nd Tuesday and Last Tuesday of every month starting at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to any category to participate in this recruitment walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website details?
faq.answer: You can visit the official Lok Nayak Hospital recruitment website at http://tte.delhigovt.nic.in/wps/wcm/connect/doit_lnip/LNJP/Home/ for further updates and detailed guidelines.
